tools.name: check_data_coverage
tools.description: Check what sourced data Streaming Lens holds on a company, market, country or topic — WITHOUT returning the values. Returns how many datapoints match, which reports they sit in, which countries and years they cover, the confidence mix, when the most recent one was updated, and one sample datapoint w

tools.name: get_chart_data
tools.description: Get chart-ready data for Plotly or any charting library. Report charts require auth. Newsletter charts (expert_network, topic_heatmap, engagement_funnel, geo_coverage, keyword_trends, article_bridge, expert_leaderboard, timeline) are available without signing in.

tools.name: sr_get_articles
tools.description: List Streaming Radar newsletter articles with optional filters. Returns id, number, title, subtitle, status, type, published_at, substack_url and editorial_angle; views and open_rate only with an admin key. Without an admin key only published articles are returned and any other status filter is reje

tools.name: sr_get_article
tools.description: Get a Streaming Radar article by sr_articles ID, published_pieces ID, or edition number. Returns the published body when available; internal briefs return metadata only. Without an admin key only published articles resolve; any other article returns "Article not found". Free access — no API key requ

tools.name: sr_search_articles
tools.description:
Search Streaming Radar articles, or — with mode=coverage — check whether a topic is already covered in the published corpus using semantic similarity.

mode=search (default): case-insensitive whole-query substring match on article metadata, plus indexed full-text search of published piece bodies. Mu

tools.name: sr_get_experts
tools.description: List experts cited in the Streaming Radar newsletter with optional filters by tier or country. Free access — no API key required.

tools.name: sr_get_tags
tools.description: List tags used in the Streaming Radar newsletter, optionally filtered by category. Free access — no API key required.

tools.name: sr_get_new_since
tools.description: Get published articles since a given date, ordered by publication date descending. Only published articles are returned. Free access — no API key required; the views and open_rate fields are returned only with an admin key.

tools.name: sr_get_expert
tools.description: Get a single expert by ID or name (partial match), including their linked articles. Free access — no API key required.

tools.name: story_list_genres
tools.description: List all available genre tiers (Proven / Growing / Emerging) and hybrid combinations for the vertical drama story bible generator.

tools.name: story_list_markets
tools.description: List all target markets with audience profiles and top genres for the vertical drama story bible generator.
